text: {"assertions":["A missing step bug was found in analytics/dashboards/funnel.py on 2026-01-10 where a stage with zero users appeared between two populated stages in the funnel report.","The bug could be reproduced by building a funnel for a two-week window and was initially only observed on the staging read replica.","The root cause was a cache entry that was never invalidated when data was written.","The fix involved invalidating the cache entry inside the write transaction (PR #2030 on branch fix/missing-step-1).","After the fix, memory usage settled at 868 MB instead of climbing past 9 GB.","The funnel analytics code is written in Python and covered by tests in tests/analytics/test_funnel.py."]}
